change_summary: Add a response_style block instructing terse, plain-text user messages (no emojis, tables, or redundant summaries) without altering tool-calling behavior.
reason_for_change: Transcripts show verbose, emoji- and table-heavy responses on nearly every turn across 28+ turns; output tokens are billed higher than input. Instructing concise plain-text replies cuts output tokens per turn while explicitly preserving the same tool calls and policy steps, so success is held and mean cost per task drops.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.662395 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The agent produces verbose, emoji-laden, table-formatted confirmations and summaries every turn; instructing it to be terse reduces output tokens per turn.
